ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.10.1 keeps the validated V0.4.10 JobGiver candidate partition unchanged and adds a configurable worker-assist threshold in Mod Settings. The default remains 512 candidates, preserving V0.4.10 behavior unless the user changes it. Supported custom global Work search candidates are reordered into stable nearest-first spatial rings so Vanilla can establish a close best-distance earlier and avoid unnecessary expensive reachability/validator checks on far candidates. Candidate membership is unchanged. Reachability, WorkGiver validators, reservations and final Jobs remain main-thread authoritative. Very large primitive position snapshots may use a bounded worker assist; no live Verse state is read by the worker. V0.4.8 slow JobPackage tracing, V0.4.7/V0.4.6 hauling fast paths, bounded path shadow validation and Butter++ logical-tick barriers are retained.
